Docs.summary: The resource ID of the public IP address associated with the managed bastion. When provided during creation, the managed bastion will reference this existing public IP address instead of creating a new one. The referenced public IP address must be in the same subscription and region as the managed cluster. When not provided during creation, AKS will automatically create a new public IP address. This field cannot be updated. To change IP address after creation, please disable and re-enable the managed bastion with the new public IP address.
